messages.subject: predictions from colext
parts:
Dear all,

more colext questions: I have a dynamic occupancy model with a couple of covariates on all four param types (in total, I have year, forest cover, elevation and date, plus polynomial and interaction terms). For first-year occupancy probability psi, my model is this:

                   Estimate        SE          z      P(>|z|)
(Intercept)      -0.1991254 0.2434451 -0.8179476 4.133871e-01
elev              1.8689137 0.3539733  5.2798156 1.293139e-07
forest            0.8125548 0.2552587  3.1832599 1.456268e-03
I(forest^2)      -0.1423763 0.1966823 -0.7238897 4.691334e-01
elev:forest       0.5481940 0.2544474  2.1544494 3.120494e-02
elev:I(forest^2) -0.6211306 0.2433530 -2.5523847 1.069883e-02

Now I would like to produce predictions of psi in a grid of elevation by forest (ep and fp are standardised covariates of length 100 each).

names(psipar) <- rownames(tmp$psi)

pred.matrix <- array(NA, dim = c(100, 100)) # Predict for 100 x 100 matrix

for(i in 1:100){

   for(j in 1:100){

      newData <- data.frame(elev=ep[i], forest=fp[j])

      pred <- predict(fm26B, type="state", newdata=newData)

      pred.matrix[i, j] <- pred$Predicted

   }

}


However, my code gives me an error message:
Fehler in nrow(X) : Objekt 'X' nicht gefunden

Any ideas of what I did wrong would be very much appreciated.

Kind regards  --  Marc

messages.subject: Re: predictions from colext
parts:
Hi Marc,

I think with colext you just have to change "state" to "psi" in the predict function and it should work as is:

for(i in 1:100){

   for(j in 1:100){

      newData <- data.frame(elev=ep[i], forest=fp[j])
pred <- predict(fm26B, type="psi", newdata=newData)

pred.matrix[i, j] <- pred$Predicted

   }

}

Cheers,
Dan
